Divide the metals Cu, Zn, Ca, Mg, Fe, Na, Li into three groups, namely reactive metals, moderately reactive metals and less reactive metals.
note: The chapter is internally inconsistent about where two of these metals sit. Fig 8.5 bands magnesium with Al, Zn, Fe, Sn, Pb (the ‘react with acids’ group), while the prose on printed p102 lists ‘sodium, calcium and magnesium’ among the reactive metals extracted by electrolysis of molten chlorides. Copper is worse: printed p104 states outright that ‘the metals in the middle of the reactivity series such as iron, zinc, lead, copper are moderately reactive’, yet printed p105 describes copper’s extraction under the heading ‘c. Extraction of less reactive metals’.
